release_notes: Stable release of merged mwongj/VOD2MLIB PR #5. Metadata filters and enabled Emby whole-show ownership cleanup archive confirmed excluded NFO-only folders outside library roots, preserving legacy/Emby metadata with a recovery manifest. Works with plugin NFO generation off and STRM-only deletion scope. Shared-source, identity, file and failure protections are retained; preview and separate archive telemetry report the outcome. NFO settings have a heading and description; all action buttons follow the existing right-aligned convention. Tested with 457 Linux regression tests, Python 3.10/3.12 CI, native Dispatcharr/Emby validation, 5,366 verified movie archives, and the A Different World orphan cleanup. Saved settings and plugin identity are preserved. No Dispatcharr source changes. Scan Emby after cleanup to remove cached empty entries.
